learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the basic concepts of optimization problems.
Students learn the necessary and sufficient conditions for optimization problems.
Students learn the concept of constrained optimization.
Students learn how to solve optimization problems.
Students learn to build optimization models for basic engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the optimization problem and conditions for optimality
Analytical and numerical solution methods for optimization problems: Gradient method, Lagrange multipliers method, Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, Dynamic optimization problem
Introduction to Mixed Integer Optimization Models
Model examples for linear optimization problems in engineering
bibliography: Practical Optimization Methods with Mathematical Applications, M. Asghar Bhatti, Springer-Verlag New York, 2000.
Practical Methods of Optimization, R. Fletcher, John Wilwy &Sons.
Eren, Yavuz, İbrahim B. Küçükdemiral, and İlker Üstoğlu. "Introduction to optimization." Optimization in renewable energy systems. Butterworth-Heinemann, 2017. 27-74.
